## Purpose / الهدف

## Safety and scientific integrity
- [ ] Scientific calculations and NASA source records were not modified, or changes are explicitly explained and verified.
- [ ] Map coordinates and projection handling were checked if relevant.
- [ ] No tokens, credentials, `.env`, `.dev.vars`, or personal data were committed.
- [ ] No deployment to production and no paid services were enabled by this PR.

## Validation
- [ ] `npm run qa` passed in a clean environment.
- [ ] Browser checks were run if navigation, map, mobile or UI behaviour changed.
- [ ] Changes to source data have reproducible NASA provenance and unit information.
- [ ] Screenshots / test evidence attached where applicable.

## Risks and rollback
What could break, and how do we revert safely?
